readme:
# DESIGN:OS (`design-os`) **Multi-runtime design operating system and CLI for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and Google Antigravity.** Install once to equip any AI coding agent with 12+ domain design skills, deterministic verification gates, 2:1 axonometric art direction, and live Figma / SVG / 3D / SwiftUI / packaging workflows. **DESIGN:OS is free** to use and modify. Source-available under PolyForm Shield 1.0.0. Install with `npx @easestart/design-os init`.

Quickstart · What it makes · Install · How it works · Commands · Limits

--- ## Why this exists AI coding agents write functional code quickly, but their default visual output suffers from inconsistent spacing, hallucinated tokens, rainbow badges, and zero verification gates. **DESIGN:OS** turns aesthetic taste and design systems engineering into deterministic, runtime-agnostic contracts. | Dimension | Generic AI / Manual Workflow | DESIGN:OS CLI (`DESIGN:OS`) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Visual Quality** | Generic purple-gradient AI slop and ad-hoc CSS | Token-locked typography, 8pt modular grid, and 2:1 axonometric art direction | | **Context Budget** | Dumping massive style guides into every prompt | Progressive skill disclosure (`SKILL.md` router + on-demand domain packs) | | **Verification** | Visual eyeballing with zero automated checks | Deterministic CLI gates (`self_check.py`, contrast, and anti-flop audits) | | **Multi-Agent Parity** | Locked to a single IDE or proprietary prompt format | One canonical skill tree across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI & Antigravity | | **Privacy & Telemetry** | Opaque cloud telemetry or unverified third-party APIs | **Zero telemetry** — 100% local execution ([`PRIVACY.md`](PRIVACY.md) audited) | --- ## Quickstart ### 1. Install the plugin or CLI **In Claude Code:** ```text /plugin marketplace add jangtrinh/design-os /plugin install design-os@design-os ``` **Or from your terminal (Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode, or standalone CLI):** ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os.git cd design-os npx @easestart/design-os init ``` ### 2. Ask in plain English Open your project in your AI coding agent and describe what you need: > "Initialize DESIGN:OS in this repo and wire our design tokens and verification gates for Claude Code and Codex." > "Audit our current frontend components against DESIGN:OS typography, spacing, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast gates." > "Scaffold a new product landing page with 2:1 axonometric B&W technical illustrations and SEO/AEO/GEO metadata." ### 3. Verify your setup ```bash python3 scripts/self_check.py ``` --- ## What it makes Every deliverable produced by `design-os` is backed by a deterministic verification gate rather than freehand AI guesswork.


Prompt: "Initialize DESIGN:OS in this repo and wire our design tokens and verification gates for Claude Code and Codex."

| Deliverable / Mode | Best for | Output Format | Verification Gate | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Multi-Runtime Skill Pack** | Wiring Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Antigravity to one design standard | `.claude-plugin + skills/` | `python3 scripts/self_check.py` | | **Design System Tokens & Gates** | Enforcing spacing, typography, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in CI | `JSON / CSS / CLI exit code` | `Zero contrast or grid violations` | | **Cross-Engine Orchestration** | Routing tasks to Figma, SVG Animation, 3D Blender, Apple SwiftUI, or Origami CAD | `Verified domain artifacts` | `13-engine ecosystem parity` | | **Design-System Guidelines Pack** | Teaching any design agent the rules a library cannot show — owner rulings, look-alike components, measured anti-patterns — and shipping them as a Figma library guidelines bundle | `design/guidelines/*.md + figma-guidelines/` | `ui ds guidelines check` — no invented names, no tampered facts, Figma's 8-file / 200 KB limits |

--- ## Installation Choose the setup that matches your AI coding agent. Every option installs the same canonical skill (`skills/design-os/SKILL.md`) and `/doctor` diagnostic suite. ### Claude Code Run these two commands inside Claude Code: ```text /plugin marketplace add jangtrinh/design-os /plugin install design-os@design-os ``` ### OpenAI Codex Install to your personal Codex skills directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os.git /tmp/design-os mkdir -p ~/.codex/skills/design-os ~/.codex/prompts cp -R /tmp/design-os/skills/design-os/* ~/.codex/skills/design-os/ cp /tmp/design-os/prompts/doctor.md ~/.codex/prompts/design-os-doctor.md rm -rf /tmp/design-os ``` ### Gemini CLI & Google Antigravity ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os.git /tmp/design-os mkdir -p ~/.gemini/skills/design-os cp -R /tmp/design-os/skills/design-os/* ~/.gemini/skills/design-os/ rm -rf /tmp/design-os ``` ### OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf & Other Agent Harnesses ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os.git /tmp/design-os mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills/design-os cp -R /tmp/design-os/skills/design-os/* ~/.agents/skills/design-os/ rm -rf /tmp/design-os ```
Verify or uninstall **Verify installation:** ```bash python3 scripts/self_check.py ``` Or run `/doctor` inside Claude Code / Codex to inspect installed skill paths, plugin manifests, and gate health. **Uninstall:** ```bash rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/design-os ~/.codex/skills/design-os ~/.gemini/skills/design-os ~/.agents/skills/design-os ```
--- ## Usage & Prompt Cookbook Once installed, `skills/design-os/SKILL.md` activates automatically when your prompt matches its domain triggers. Browse [`docs/cookbook.md`](docs/cookbook.md) for copy-paste prompt recipes. **Generate & Scaffold** ```text "Initialize DESIGN:OS in this repo and wire our design tokens and verification gates for Claude Code and Codex." ``` **Audit & Verify** ```text "Audit our current frontend components against DESIGN:OS typography, spacing, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast gates." ``` **Export & Automate** ```text "Scaffold a new product landing page with 2:1 axonometric B&W technical illustrations and SEO/AEO/GEO metadata." ``` --- ## Commands & Diagnostics | Command | Environment | What it does | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/doctor` | Claude Code / Codex | Read-only diagnostic check of installed skill paths, plugin manifests, and runtime prerequisites | | `python3 scripts/self_check.py` | Terminal / CI | Deterministic offline verification of manifests, skill contracts, and governance files | | `npx @easestart/design-os doctor` | Terminal / CI | Inspect active runtime adapters (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity) and installed skill packs | | `ui taste-lint` — 35 absolute checks | Terminal / CI | Generated-UI taste checks across motion, typography, spacing, and focus states | | `ui validate-layout` — 20 checks | Terminal / CI | Structural and overflow safety checks (`100vw` traps, unclosed tags, sticky overflow) | | `ui content-lint` — 15 checks | Terminal / CI | Honest copy checks (placeholder text, lorem-ipsum, generic names, all-caps shouting) | | `ui tell-lint` — 43 checks, any language | Terminal / CI | Polyglot design-tell checks across HTML, JSX/TSX, Vue, Svelte, CSS, SwiftUI, and Flutter | | `ui ds guidelines build \| check \| export --target figma` | Terminal / CI | Compile a cited guidelines pack from your sealed design system, rulings and glossary; lint it; export a ready-to-upload Figma library guidelines bundle | | `skills/design-os-designer` — `build.mjs`, `validate.mjs`, `look.mjs` | Any agent runtime | The shipped design skill: build an evidence folder for a page, run `ui gate` plus file checks, render a three-width sheet with measured items; `ui init` wires it into Claude Code, Antigravity and Codex | --- ## How it works 1. **Intent Routing** — Your AI agent matches your request against `skills/design-os/SKILL.md` frontmatter triggers. 2. **Progressive Context Loading** — Only the entry-point `SKILL.md` router loads initially; detailed recipes and scripts load on demand. 3. **Deterministic Execution** — Domain scripts and contracts execute locally with reproducible inputs and outputs. 4. **Gate Verification** — `scripts/self_check.py` and domain verifiers (`npx @easestart/design-os init`) validate the artifact before completion. 5. **Zero-Telemetry Delivery** — Verified files are written directly to your workspace with zero external network calls. ```text User Prompt / CLI Invocation │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ skills/design-os/SKILL.md │ Progressive disclosure router & hard rules │ └───────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘ │ loads on demand ▼ ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ npx @easestart/design-os doctor │ Deterministic build & contract enforcement │ └───────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘ │ verifies ▼ ┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ python3 scripts/self_check.py + /doctor │ │ Zero-telemetry local verification gate │ └───────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### What loads when `design-os` uses progressive context disclosure so your agent's context window stays fast and focused: | File | Loaded when | | :--- | :--- | | `skills/design-os/SKILL.md` | Always (~100–150 lines) — routing rules, triggers, and execution workflow | | `docs/cookbook.md` | When selecting multi-step prompt recipes or domain patterns | | `commands/doctor.md` / `prompts/doctor.md` | Only when running `/doctor` diagnostics | | `llms.txt` | When indexed by AI answer engines, RAG pipelines, or repo crawlers | --- ## File structure ```text design-os/ ├── .claude-plugin/ │ ├── plugin.json # Claude Code plugin manifest │ └── marketplace.json # Claude Code marketplace catalog ├── .codex-plugin/ │ └── plugin.json # OpenAI Codex plugin & interface manifest ├── .agents/ │ └── plugins/marketplace.json # Cross-agent local plugin registry ├── .factory-plugin/ │ ├── plugin.json # Factory / Droid plugin manifest │ └── marketplace.json # Factory marketplace metadata ├── skills/ │ └── design-os/ │ └── SKILL.md # Canonical agent skill entrypoint ├── commands/ │ └── doctor.md # /doctor diagnostic slash command ├── prompts/ │ └── doctor.md # Codex diagnostic prompt mirror ├── scripts/ │ └── self_check.py # Deterministic repository & skill self-check ├── docs/ │ ├── cookbook.md # Copy-paste prompt recipes by job │ └── llms.txt # GEO / LLM discovery index ├── PRIVACY.md # Zero-telemetry & local-first privacy commitment ├── SECURITY.md # Vulnerability disclosure & security policy ├── CONTRIBUTING.md # Contribution workflow & verification rules ├── CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md # Contributor Covenant code of conduct ├── CHANGELOG.md # Release history ├── llms.txt # Root LLM indexing manifest ├── LICENSE # PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 └── README.md ``` --- ## Quality bar & Limitations ### It's working if... - `python3 scripts/self_check.py` prints `ok: design-os self-check passed (design-os)` and exits `0`. - `npx @easestart/design-os init` passes with zero contract or test regressions. - Your AI coding agent loads `skills/design-os/SKILL.md` automatically when given any prompt from [`docs/cookbook.md`](docs/cookbook.md). - Network traffic during execution remains zero (guaranteed by [`PRIVACY.md`](PRIVACY.md)). ### When not to use - Throwaway backend scripts with zero user-facing UI, CLI, or documentation surface. - Teams looking for a hosted cloud SaaS design tool rather than a local-first, git-tracked engineering toolchain. - Replacing human brand strategy — DESIGN:OS enforces and scales design systems, not customer discovery. --- ## Watch DESIGN:OS is free and source-available (PolyForm Shield). The Autonomous Design Agent talks from the [design:os by Jang](https://www.youtube.com/@designosbyjang) channel (Vietnamese, with English terms):

Installation

Choose the setup that matches your AI coding agent. Every option installs the same canonical skill (skills/design-os/SKILL.md) and /doctor diagnostic suite.

Claude Code

Run these two commands inside Claude Code:


/plugin marketplace add jangtrinh/design-os

/plugin install design-os@design-os

OpenAI Codex

Install to your personal Codex skills directory:


git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os.git /tmp/design-os

mkdir -p ~/.codex/skills/design-os ~/.codex/prompts

cp -R /tmp/design-os/skills/design-os/* ~/.codex/skills/design-os/

cp /tmp/design-os/prompts/doctor.md ~/.codex/prompts/design-os-doctor.md

rm -rf /tmp/design-os

Gemini CLI & Google Antigravity


git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os.git /tmp/design-os

mkdir -p ~/.gemini/skills/design-os

cp -R /tmp/design-os/skills/design-os/* ~/.gemini/skills/design-os/

rm -rf /tmp/design-os

OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf & Other Agent Harnesses


git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os.git /tmp/design-os

mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills/design-os

cp -R /tmp/design-os/skills/design-os/* ~/.agents/skills/design-os/

rm -rf /tmp/design-os

Commands & Diagnostics

| Command | Environment | What it does |

| :--- | :--- | :--- |

| /doctor | Claude Code / Codex | Read-only diagnostic check of installed skill paths, plugin manifests, and runtime prerequisites |

| python3 scripts/self_check.py | Terminal / CI | Deterministic offline verification of manifests, skill contracts, and governance files |

| npx @easestart/design-os doctor | Terminal / CI | Inspect active runtime adapters (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity) and installed skill packs |

| ui taste-lint — 35 absolute checks | Terminal / CI | Generated-UI taste checks across motion, typography, spacing, and focus states |

| ui validate-layout — 20 checks | Terminal / CI | Structural and overflow safety checks (100vw traps, unclosed tags, sticky overflow) |

| ui content-lint — 15 checks | Terminal / CI | Honest copy checks (placeholder text, lorem-ipsum, generic names, all-caps shouting) |

| ui tell-lint — 43 checks, any language | Terminal / CI | Polyglot design-tell checks across HTML, JSX/TSX, Vue, Svelte, CSS, SwiftUI, and Flutter |

| ui ds guidelines build \| check \| export --target figma | Terminal / CI | Compile a cited guidelines pack from your sealed design system, rulings and glossary; lint it; export a ready-to-upload Figma library guidelines bundle |

| skills/design-os-designer — build.mjs, validate.mjs, look.mjs | Any agent runtime | The shipped design skill: build an evidence folder for a page, run ui gate plus file checks, render a three-width sheet with measured items; ui init wires it into Claude Code, Antigravity and Codex |

How it works

1. Intent Routing — Your AI agent matches your request against skills/design-os/SKILL.md frontmatter triggers.

2. Progressive Context Loading — Only the entry-point SKILL.md router loads initially; detailed recipes and scripts load on demand.

3. Deterministic Execution — Domain scripts and contracts execute locally with reproducible inputs and outputs.

4. Gate Verification — scripts/self_check.py and domain verifiers (npx @easestart/design-os init) validate the artifact before completion.

5. Zero-Telemetry Delivery — Verified files are written directly to your workspace with zero external network calls.

Quality bar & Limitations

It's working if...

  • python3 scripts/self_check.py prints ok: design-os self-check passed (design-os) and exits 0.
  • npx @easestart/design-os init passes with zero contract or test regressions.
  • Your AI coding agent loads skills/design-os/SKILL.md automatically when given any prompt from [docs/cookbook.md](docs/cookbook.md).
  • Network traffic during execution remains zero (guaranteed by [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md)).

When not to use

  • Throwaway backend scripts with zero user-facing UI, CLI, or documentation surface.
  • Teams looking for a hosted cloud SaaS design tool rather than a local-first, git-tracked engineering toolchain.
  • Replacing human brand strategy — DESIGN:OS enforces and scales design systems, not customer discovery.
